visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair and a white t-shirt introduces a large white bowl of noodles to the camera while gesturing enthusiastically. Yellow and white variety-style captions appear at the top. The background is a clean indoor living room with a grey sofa and a wooden shelf. (2) Close-up shot of a packaged meal from FamilyMart titled 'Cold Noodles with Chicken, Sichuan Pepper & Scallion'. A hand holds the package briefly before the scene cuts. (3) The camera angle shifts to a top-down view of the bowl. Hands pour two dark, translucent preserved eggs (century eggs) from a container onto the bed of wide white noodles and shredded chicken. (4) A block of smooth white tofu is added to the bowl from a 'Chung Hwa Tofu' plastic container. The tofu sits prominently in the center. (5) Dark savory sauce is drizzled over the tofu and eggs, followed by a bright orange-red chili oil. (6) A metal fork is used to vigorously stir the ingredients, breaking the tofu and preserved eggs into smaller pieces and mixing them with the noodles until they form a creamy, textured coating. (7) The man sits on a grey couch, holding the bowl and using black chopsticks to lift a large portion of the mixed noodles. He looks directly at the camera with an expressive, excited face. (8) He takes a large bite of the noodles and reacts with wide eyes and a smile, indicating intense flavor. (9) Multiple close-up shots show the chopsticks lifting the glistening, sauce-covered noodles to emphasize their texture. (10) The man holds a smartphone, showing the Uber Eats app interface. (11) Screen recordings show the user navigating the Uber Eats app, selecting items from a 'FamilyMart' store listing. Price tags like $69, $45, and $23 are visible on various food items. (12) The man lies down on the grey sofa while looking at his phone, then sits up to point at a large green graphic containing a promo code and discount information.

(3) A distinct metallic scraping and mixing sound of a fork against a ceramic bowl is present for several seconds, accompanied by stylized bubble-pop sound effects that match the visual edit. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the audio shifts to the screen recording section. The vocal tone becomes more informative and instructional while maintaining high arousal.
